N_rationale: Phase-2 dose-response on plt: liftoff at ~250 examples (65.7% of the total 0->4000 perplexity gain), plateau 250->1000, further gain by 4000. N=2000 puts full-data well past the liftoff while keeping fair-share kept-at-budget amounts (N*b = 20/100/200 at 1/5/10%) on the STEEPEST part of the curve, where selector differences are most detectable. All 7 decisive languages have >=3x N usable in MURI-IT.

dropped_languages.bod: MURI usable ~1655 < N (3311 raw x 50% GlotLID yield); also only marginally above chance in R3 (lower bound 0.252).
dropped_languages.tsn: MURI usable ~933 < N (4668 raw x 20% GlotLID yield); also marginal in R3 (lower bound 0.263).
dropped_languages.wol: MURI usable ~891 < N (4457 raw x 20% GlotLID yield); also marginal in R3 (lower bound 0.253).

notes: GlotLID yield matters: MURI configs are ISO 639-3 and can contain related-language or off-target text. plt is drawn from the Malagasy MACROLANGUAGE config 'mlg' (99% GlotLID->plt).
bod/tsn/wol fail BOTH filters independently (marginally-above-chance in R3 AND insufficient native MURI supply), so dropping them is not a post-hoc convenience.
Concentrated rebuild: 7 languages x N=2000 = 14000 injected into the 10755 non-target base -> ~24755 pool (~57% injected). This is deliberately multilingual-heavy; results describe that regime.
